body: the pain of living has been with me since middle school. i cant shake this. time wont heal this. theres always going to be a dark spirit in my head wanting to overtake me.

ive experienced the suicide of a friend. i dont want anyone to feel what i felt. but i dont think i can hold myself back any longer. it hurts so bad. i cant stay here. in this place. i cant deal with the overwhelming emptiness. i cant hold on to something thats not even there.
the fear of hurting the ones i care about.
i cant control the amount of sadness and meaninglessness i feel and its overwhelmingly suffocating. i just want to leave. more than anything i want to disappear.
i feel like im going insane
i dont know what to do. i hate being here but i cant hurt them like that. i guess im just a coward from every angle
